summary: One church, Hungarian parish. No schedule box: the weekly Masses come from the p1 intentions tables of both bulletins (R35), matching the website's Mass Times page: Sat 4:30 PM English, Sun 11:00 AM Hungarian, Fri 6:30 PM Hungarian (website: omitted in summer, months not given). Advent Saturday 7 AM Roráté Masses are announced without dates and left out (R20/R33). No Confession or Adoration times anywhere. No open questions.

R35, R1: the Sunday 11:00 AM (H) Mass is in the intentions table of both bulletins for Nov 8, 15 and 22, and announcements refer to 'the Sunday 11am Mass' (p2); the website gives the same standing time. (H) is Hungarian.

The bulletin prints no dates and gives the season only as 'Advent', which no month season or weekly slot expresses truthfully; POLICY forbids projecting dates. Update mode will read the Advent bulletins.
